text: Councilmember/Businessowner

When I took the oath to serve on the Irvine City Council, I promised to put Irvine first and deliver results. I have kept that promise by strengthening public safety through my service on the Orange County Fire Authority Board, expanding support for seniors and working families, protecting our beloved University Park Library, hosting Irvine's first Women's Conference, and launching our city's bike share pilot.

More than 30 years ago, I came to America picking apples and cleaning hotel rooms. After surviving domestic violence, Human Options helped my two daughters and me find safe, affordable housing in Irvine. I worked hard, earned a Master of Public Administration from USC, built a successful small business, and never forgot the opportunities this community gave my family.

I am running for reelection to keep our neighborhoods safe, our city financially strong, and our local businesses thriving. I want to make Irvine more affordable and ensure seniors, working families, and financially vulnerable residents are not left behind.
Irvine gave my family a new beginning. I will keep working every day to protect the opportunities that make our city one of America's best places to live. I respectfully ask for your vote.
Learn more at bettyforirvine.com.

text: Housing Specialist

Decisions made by the Irvine City Council affect our quality of life today and our city's future. Residents deserve a councilmember with the integrity to do what is right, the compassion to understand people, and the sound judgment to make thoughtful, independent decisions.

My professional experience, combined with my education at the University of California, Irvine, has prepared me for this responsibility. I have extensive experience evaluating proposals, negotiating contracts, and solving complex problems. These are the same skills needed to review budgets, development agreements, public contracts, and the many other important issues before the City Council. Careful analysis, thoughtful questions, and informed decisions lead to better outcomes.

Volunteering with Irvine Meals on Wheels, Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County, and serving on the Board of Directors for UCI Health Family Health Centers has strengthened my understanding of our community and reinforced my commitment of service.
I am dedicated to protecting public safety, preserving open space, supporting responsible growth, and safeguarding Irvine's exceptional quality of life.
I would be honored to earn your vote and serve the residents of District 5.

Julie Glossbrenner
JulieForIrvine.com

text: City of Irvine Commissioner
I grew up in Irvine, attended our public schools, and have spent my life serving the city that gave me so much.

I served eight years as an Irvine Commissioner and four years as your City Councilmember, working to keep Irvine America’s Safest City for our size, protect our quality of life, promote transparency and accountability, and safeguard taxpayer dollars.
In my final year on the City Council, Irvine projected a budget surplus nearing $30,000,000, and I led the effort to return nearly $5,000,000 to taxpayers.

I will restore fiscal discipline at City Hall and build on my record of strengthening public safety; fighting for greater affordability while protecting our quality of life; and ensuring residents have a meaningful voice in decisions about our neighborhoods.
Public service isn’t about titles. It’s about listening, doing the homework, asking tough questions, working collaboratively, making tough decisions, and delivering results.
You’ve trusted me to serve. I’ve always put Irvine first. I’ve done it before, and I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and do it again.
I respectfully ask for your vote so together we can protect what makes Irvine special and build a stronger, healthier future for our city.

Anthony Kuo
AnthonyKuo.org

text: Cybersecurity Manager/Father

I'm an Iraq War veteran. I've called Irvine home for 40 years. I grew up here going to Springbrook Elementary School, Lakeside Middle School, Woodbridge High School, and Irvine Valley College. I worked as a Public Safety Assistant for the Irvine Police Department and served as a reserve firefighter with the Orange County Fire Authority.

After Iraq, I found another way to serve close to home. I'm the Cubmaster for our local scout pack, 50 families strong. I built the bridge our scouts cross at graduation. I also built the safety team for Orange County's pro-democracy rallies. I helped keep our neighbors safe as they exercised their right to speak out.

I rode my bike to the University Park Library growing up, and my kids have too. Irvine now runs its own library system, and families drive to Tustin for better selection. I'll get our community involved in building an Irvine library system that brings those families back.
Irvine also faces a real budget shortfall. We deserve a council that works toward real transparency and accountability, and one that listens and follows through for every resident.
I'm running because this city gave my family a chance, and I want to keep building that chance for the next one. It would be an honor to earn your vote.

text: Small Businessowner/Dad
With traffic getting worse, roads in need of repair, and a growing budget deficit, we need to bring the focus back to what really matters to the residents of District 5.

As your councilmember, I will bring disciplined, fiscally responsible leadership, professionalism, and bridge-building skills honed over years of doing business around the world. My priorities: balancing the budget without cutting essential services; protecting public safety; maintaining infrastructure; and keeping the University Park Library open.

I have called Woodbridge home for 31 years, raising two children, and volunteering for over 14 years in local Scouting. My wife and I built our life together in this community, and we will celebrate our 30th anniversary in November.

I served as Chief of Staff to our Vice Mayor, working on Irvine's major issues, including the budget deficit. I built strong relationships with city staff and department directors, engaged with residents, and supported local businesses.
I have successfully run my own international business since 2005, and I serve on the Irvine Community Alliance Fund board.
District 5 deserves a representative with deep community roots, real experience, and the judgment to protect what makes Irvine work. I am ready to serve on day one.
www.stevenalves4irvine.com
